svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 01/12 Aldrich Park (Legendary)
svg.desc: The park at the center of the ring. Every building faces it, so every walk crosses it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
